title: fed / repo / money markets | Research Paper | The Fed Has Two Tools to Influence Money Market Conditions
summary: NY Fed staff economists Adam Copeland and Owen Engbretson analyze how the Fed's two policy tools—administrative rates (IORB) and balance sheet size (Fed liabilities)—independently affect money market conditions. Using confidential trade-level data from the OFR centrally cleared repo collection, they find both tools significantly affect dealer spreads in Treasury repo markets. The research quantifies how changes in IORB and Fed liabilities shift the liquidity risk premium dealers charge to intermediate funding.
